description: Implementation of the LanguageService interface, providing methods to retrieve and manage language entities, convert between Language and Locale objects, and cache language data.

classes.name: LanguageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for language-related operations, extending generic service and implementing LanguageService interface, with caching and locale conversion features.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its code.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object to a Locale object.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Locale object to a Language entity.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language entities.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all languages, utilizing cache for performance.
